text: The reception lounge stretches around a bronze crocodile whose polished eyes face the balcony. Music and animal noises drift down from the court above. A scratched route card lies beneath one sofa.

views.text: The lounge is dim and worn. Cheap chairs sag beside a bronze crocodile, while barking, braying, and badly played instruments echo from beyond the balcony.
The lounge is broad and perfumed, furnished with plush chairs around a gleaming bronze crocodile. Laughter and music rise from a palace party beyond the balcony.
